alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right. The blue one starts a story with a bubble so I got there... The amber one tilts in with wide eyes and a bubble says and then? The blue one lights up, eyes happy, and says the door was locked! The amber one answers no way! with a pulse. The text stays: me asking and then what.
